notes:
PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/carlosferrazza__humanoid-bench --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware run. The package targets h1-stand-v0 and uses native humanoid_bench.env:HumanoidEnv, the card's AST entry symbol; the card's family-config decision and the GymnasiumDriver helper express the interface, so there is no deviation from the card. The fake backend is a pure-Python analytic stand-in for the MuJoCo environment: it exposes the model's 19-value action space and 51-value qpos+qvel observation, but it models no contacts, actuator forces, the stand reward, termination, the 1000-step limit or the upstream numpy random stream, and it was never compared with upstream. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('h1-stand-v0') after importing humanoid_bench) was not run: gymnasium, mujoco and dm_control are not installed here. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed used by the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset (inherited from gymnasium's MujocoEnv, which the clone's AST cannot follow); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
